name: Sinful Valley
source:
Sinful Valley is a game about a female protagonist and her household's economical struggle while trying to keep normalcy during changing times. Will she be able to keep her peaceful life as it was? Will she change with the city? Will she eventually throw her past away and find a new and exciting life?

That will be up to you!

[Edited from F95Zone]
translation:
《Sinful Valley》讲述一位女主人公与家人面临经济困境，并在变化的时代里努力维持正常生活的故事。她能守住往日平静的生活吗？她会随着城市一同改变吗？她最终会抛下过去，找到全新而刺激的人生吗？

这一切都由你决定！

[编译自F95Zone]
